args.goal: Showcase: crewed Mun landing and return with Lander 4 (narrow, ledge-free, six legs). MechJeb flies ascent and trans-Mun injection; ASTRA's predictor-guided fly_descent lands; Jebediah plants a flag and comes home.

result.goal: Showcase: crewed Mun landing and return with Lander 4 (narrow, ledge-free, six legs). MechJeb flies ascent and trans-Mun injection; ASTRA's predictor-guided fly_descent lands; Jebediah plants a flag and comes home.
relevant_lessons: - [2026-09-30] (design, eva, landing) A wide base under a narrow pod leaves a ledge: the kerbal climbs out onto the tank top instead of the ground, and walking off it pushed a 6.8 t lander over in Mun gravity (twice). Keep the hatch clear of any shelf below it so the kerbal drops straight to the ground.

- [2026-06-27] (landing, design) A lander engine enclosed by its own interstage shroud had its exhaust blocked: full throttle, fuel draining, g-force 0 (an LV-N at trans-Mun injection). Engines that stay attached must have bare bells.

- [2026-09-30] (landing, design, eva) A 3-legged single-stack Mun lander (FL-T400 + Terrier, pod on top, LT-2 legs) rocked +-7 deg on a 5.7 deg slope and fell over twice: once when the kerbal dropped out of the hatch, once after the vessel switch that follows boarding. Use 4 legs or a wider base, and lift off promptly after boarding.

- [2026-06-27] (landing, design, eva) A tall, narrow single-stack lander tipped over on Duna, burying the hatch and blocking both the flag and the ascent. Design for a tip-over angle well above the expected slopes (wide stance, low centre of mass) and check tilt before any surface ignition.

- [2026-06-27] (transfer) Every correction must keep the parking or return periapsis safe: one Mun correction lowered the Kerbin periapsis to 27 km and the craft reentered. For crews, prefer trajectories with a recoverable free return.

- [2026-06-27] (eva) FlightEVA.spawnEVA returns null when no hatch is free: a heat shield directly below a Mk1 pod blocked EVA at the Mun; radial chutes, panels, and an RTG blocked it at Duna. The hatch was inferred to face the −180..0° azimuth half of the pod but that was never re-verified; test EVA on the pad.

- [2026-06-27] (landing) Mun terminal-descent failures: a fixed 30 m suicide-burn margin forced near-full throttle near the ground (bounce, drift, dry tanks); a capped hover from 250 m oscillated and burned the return fuel; lateral cleanup starting at 120 m with 7.5 m/s sideways was too late (impact at 18.8 m/s); switching to vertical while drifting preserved the slide. Null the horizontal speed before contact and stay retrograde until it is small.

- [2026-06-27] (mun, transfer, capture) Stopping an injection burn as soon as any Mun SOI appeared gave a grazing 2.1 Mm periapsis whose capture was unaffordable; stop on a capture-grade predicted periapsis.

args.summary: Lander 4 (narrow, six legs) landed at 0.03 m/s, but it is only marginally stable on a 4.6 deg slope: with the pilot out (no SAS) it tipped, even after the new jetpack hop carried Jebediah clear without touching it. Resuming Lander 3 (wide base) from its landed checkpoint, now with the hop.
